evidence: Architect: Torti Gallas -- the I-195 Redevelopment District's own project page for Emblem 125 (125 Clifford Street), developer EQT Exeter. Written under the practice's full name, Torti Gallas + Partners, because 'Torti Gallas' alone reads as a person.
The design, developed by ZDS ARCHITECTURE & INTERIOR, includes a variety of apartment sizes ranging from studios to three-bedroom units -- 21 Atwells Ave, 216 units, The Procaccianti Group

DBVW's own project page for 434 Atwells Avenue, services 'Architecture, Interior Design': The Avenue is an 85-unit affordable housing development that strengthens two Providence neighborhoods -- client ONE Neighborhood Builders

The new building is designed by Union Studio Architecture and Design and will feature enclosed parking for 61 vehicles, topped by four floors of apartments -- 99-101 Gano Street, HV Collins Co., 61 units
3SIX0's own project page for the Community MusicWorks Center at 1326 Westminster Street; the mass-timber building opened September 2024

Architect: Elkus Manfredi -- I-195 District project page for the Aloft Hotel, developer 'CV Properties and Boston Andes Capital', matching DRC Application 17.05, 229 Dyer Street, Proposed Aloft Hotel. Written under the practice's full name, Elkus Manfredi Architects.
All renderings by Gerner Kronick + Valcarcel Architects, DPC -- credited on the 12-story mixed-use proposal for 151-155 Chestnut Street, the scheme in DRC Application 19.36

the architects on the project are Kevin Diamond and Dustin Dezube principals in Providence Architecture and Building Company -- four-story, 58-unit development at 103 Evergreen Street approved by the City Plan Commission

Project architect Harry Wheeler (JCJ Architecture) presented updated renderings -- Waites Wharf hotel, Newport; Wheeler spent 27 years at Group One Partners, which JCJ acquired in 2023, so earlier coverage of the same application credits Group One

Title block of the DPR submission drawing filed with the city: '18 Fifth Avenue East Greenwich, Rhode Island 02818 ... mcgeorgeai.com' over CLIENT: THE OMNI GROUP, PROJECT: 870 WESTMINISTER BANK, 870 WESTMINSTER STREET PROVIDENCE, RI

Title block of the plan set filed with case 19-007MI: 'ARCHITECT: UNION STUDIO ARCHITECTURE & COMMUNITY DESIGN 140 UNION STREET PROVIDENCE, RI 02903' -- 200 Gordon Ave and 445 Prairie Ave preliminary plan

Title block on the drawing sheets filed with case 21-020MA: 'ARCHITECT ZDS inc. 2 CHARLES STREET, SUITE A1 PROVIDENCE, RI 02904' -- written under the practice's trading name, ZDS Architecture & Interior Design

Drawing title block filed with case 21-017MI: 'Architect: FREECELL ARCHITECTURE, 57 35TH ST, BROOKLYN NY 11232, WWW.FRCLL.COM'. The separate 'LANDSCAPE ARCHITECT: 57 HUDSON ST. PROVIDENCE' block on the landscape sheet is Design Under Sky, not the building architect

Cover sheet of the preliminary submission for case 22-056MI, 'New Development for: 300 Valley Street Residential': 'ARCHITECT Ed Wojcik, Architect, Ltd., One Richmond Square, Suite 100K, Providence, RI 02906' (civil engineer listed separately as D'Amico Engineering Technology)

Cover sheet G001.00 of the case 25-019MI submission, project '1107 WESTMINSTER MIXED USE': 'ARCHITECT FREECELL ARCHITECTURE LLC, 57 35TH STREET UNIT B516, BROOKLYN NY 11232', stamped by registered architect Lauren Crahan

Cover sheet of the Development Plan Review submission for Montessori Community School of Rhode Island, 73 + 78 Stanwood Street: title block 'PRSIC & PRSIC' with the registered-architect stamp of Almin Prsic (RI 4813). Written without the diacritics the sheet uses (Prsic & Prsic)
Title block of sheet A-1 for 547 Chalkstone Ave, A.P. 69 Lot 261: 'mag associates inc. architecture . planning . interiors, 61 Potter Street, East Providence, RI 02914'

Cover sheet title block for '528 CHARLES ST - PROVIDENCE RI 02908, CHANGING OCCUPANCY AND REMODELING ON FIRST FLOOR': 'ARCHITECT JEFFREY LYKINS, 110-1/2 SOUTH KILLINGLY ROAD, FOSTER RI 02825', with a RI registered architect stamp. A person, not a practice

Sheet footer of the March 2022 DDRC submission drawings for 71 Richmond Street: 'EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS -- MARCH 2022 | Truth Box Inc' beside the 'truth box ARCHITECTS' logo. ArtInRuins credits Monika Kraemer as the designing architect on the project
I-195 Redevelopment District project page for Parcel 6 (135 Wickenden Street): 'Developer: D+P Real Estate and Truth Box Inc  Architect: Truth Box Inc. and ZDS'

Project team for the new Pawtucket Unified High School at 2 Columbus Avenue (the former McCoy Stadium site): Shawmut Design and Construction as builder, Colliers Project Leaders as owner's project manager, and Jonathan Levi Architects as lead architect -- a $326M, 375,000 sf complex

Dimeo Construction's project page for the Offshore Wind Facility at the Port of Providence is titled 'Architect - Wood Architects, PLC'. Dimeo was the general contractor on the Orsted/Eversource foundation-component facility at ProvPort, the project filed as case 20-005MA by North East Offshore LLC at 7 Harborside Boulevard

Drawing title block in the city's 288 Kinsley Ave / 153 Harris Ave submission: 'CORDTSEN DESIGN ARCHITECTURE, 42 West Main Road, Middletown, RI 02842, CordtsenDesign.com' (DiPrete Engineering appears separately as the civil engineer)

Same 288 Kinsley Ave development as project 702 -- this row is the freestanding-sign variance for the site. Drawing title block: 'CORDTSEN DESIGN ARCHITECTURE, 42 West Main Road, Middletown, RI 02842'

Cover sheet of the case 22-063MI preliminary submission, 'New Development for: 322 Washington St. Residential Units': 'ARCHITECT Ed Wojcik, Architect, Ltd., One Richmond Square, Suite 100K, Providence, RI 02906'; civil engineer D'Amico Engineering Technology, landscape architect Diane Soule and Associates

Elevations sheet in the case 20-036MI preliminary plan package: 'ELEVATIONS AND MATERIAL BOARD -- MARCELLO STREET APARTMENTS, SEPTEMBER 2020' under the ZDS logo. Written under the practice's trading name, ZDS Architecture & Interior Design
